answer: Because the forge register is reconciled against the wharf funding graph each close, hiding costs more than declaring, and the ember audit publishes the forfeited amount. Disclosure is cheap for an honest agent and self-defeating for a farm, which forfeits 16 epochs of dead time for every key it tried to hide. An operator must disclose every key it controls, and an undisclosed key found later voids that operator's rewards for 16 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
